plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: An agent graph that improves itself: /agent-loop:lead preflights the repo, plans a task in small units, runs test-writer and implementer agents, then verification and independent review specialists chosen for the change's risks, recording what each caught; /agent-loop:dispatch runs several leads in the background, each in its own worktree, checks their claims and pushes their stacked branches only on your approval; /agent-loop:retro mines those records and your session transcripts for recurring mistakes, promotes fixes up a ladder (instruction, check, hook, test) behind a human gate, and checks that each rule actually worked.

plugins.name: agent-ready
plugins.description: Audit how ready a repository is for agentic development: /agent-ready:audit collects evidence read-only, judges each layer on whether it exists, runs in CI, blocks merge and is measured, names the adoption step the repo supports and its bottleneck, and lists fixes prioritised by agent impact.
